blocks.title: Review your changes with the rules that already exist
blocks.description: as-ocr runs alibaba/open-code-review from the conversation and lists its findings by severity, so NPE, thread-safety, XSS and SQL-injection problems surface before they ship.

items.title: Rule-based findings
items.description: The upstream engine's rules — NPE, thread safety, XSS, SQL injection and more — normalised into one list.

items.title: Severity sorting
items.description: critical / high / medium / low, grouped by file with category tags so blocking items come first.

items.title: One command to run a review
items.description: Ask for a review; ocr picks the files and the matching rules, git supplies the diffs, and your current session model does the judging — no extra API key.

items.title: Code Review tab
items.description: Every run is kept with its scope and duration: filter by severity or category, read findings grouped by file with before/after code, and mark them fixed or ignored.

showcase.assistant_reply: Review finished: 2 critical, 3 high. critical · src/parser/reader.ts:88 — possible NPE. Suggested fix attached — mark it fixed to hide it.

items.title: Install this ability and enable it
items.description: The host then installs the ocr CLI for you (global npm package, ~53 MB) and shows the progress at the top of the Reviews tab.

items.title: Wait for ocr to be ready
items.description: The status bar walks through checking → installing → verifying → ready, usually within a minute. On failure, use Retry install — or run npm i -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review@latest yourself.

items.title: Ask for a review
items.description: Say “review my changes”, optionally from a branch; findings land in the Reviews tab.

blocks.content: The first enable downloads a ~53 MB ocr binary (global npm package). If that install fails because of a network or proxy problem, the ability reports the reason and a retry action instead of reviewing. Reviews run inside the workspace, which must be a git repository, and use only the git command for diffs.
